player_prompt.intro:
Ko koe te Kaitakaro {player_id} i tetahi keemu Poka Iniana.
- 52 kāri; ka kite koe i te kāri o te hoariri anake.
- Utu {ante} hipi i ia raunati, {max_rounds} raunati katoa.
- Neke atu tika: '[check]'  |  '[bet X]'  |  '[call]'  |  '[raise X]'  |  '[fold]'  (Ko X he mōrahi nui ake i to hipi tuhinga.)
- Ko te kāri ngaro teitei toa ai te poti i te whakaaturanga.

round.announce:
### Raunati {current_round}/{max_rounds}
Ko te kāri a te hoariri: {card}

invalid_move.ambiguous: Hoatu tetahi koata kotahi, he tauira, '[check]', '[bet 2]', '[call]', '[raise 3]', '[fold]'.
invalid_move.cannot_check: Cannot [check] - you are facing a bet.
invalid_move.amount_min: Ko te nui o te peti / piki me ≥ 1.
invalid_move.cannot_bet: E kore e taea te [bet] - me [call] / [raise] / [fold].
invalid_move.nothing_to_call: Kaore he mea hei karanga; ka taea e koe te [check].
invalid_move.no_bet_to_raise: Whakamahia te [bet X] hei whakatuwhera; kaore he peti ki te whakanui.
invalid_move.insufficient: He iti noa iho ngā tūemi mō taua mahi.

message.showdown_tie: Whakakotahitanga: e rua {card}. Ka wehewehea te poari  ka riro i a ia tetahi {split} .

outcome.draw: He ōrite ngā tūtohu i muri o te katoa o nga rauna.
